title: Minutes to Downtown | Skyline Rooftop Views
description:
Welcome to your Nashville sanctuary! This thoughtfully designed retreat offers everything your group needs…a private rooftop with downtown skyline views, cozy fire pit for evening gatherings, and the perfect location that balances adventure with relaxation. End your Nashville nights around the rooftop fire pit, skyline glowing in the distance, sharing stories about the day. Broadway and the Grand Ole Opry are just 10 minutes away, plus you’ve got free garage parking.

The space
★Highlights★
- Rooftop with fire pit + Nashville Skyline Views + Gas Grill
- 3 miles from downtown
- Professionally Decorated
- Fully Stocked Chef's Kitchen

★★Must Climb Stairs★★

Layout

★Level One★
2 Car Garage 2  (Trucks/SUVs longer than 21’6” will NOT fit in garage)
Laundry Room - Full Sized Washer + Dryer (pods and dryer sheets included)
Bedroom One - Queen Bed, Smart TV + Full ensuite Bathroom with Shower/Tub combo, Room Darkening Drapes

★Level Two★
Bedroom Two - Queen over Queen Built in Beds + Room Darkening Drapes
Bedroom Three - Queen Bed, Smart TV + Room Darkening Drapes
Hallway Bathroom - Full Bathroom with Shower/Tub combo 
Bedroom Four - Queen Bed, Smart TV + Full ensuite Bathroom

★Level Three★
Kitchen - Fully Stocked, Gourmet Kitchen w/Island Seating + Dining Table + Coffee/Tea Station
Half Bathroom
Living Room with Queen Sofa Sleeper + Smart TV

★Level Four★
Rooftop - Dining Area, Soft Seating, Gas Grill + Fire Pit
VIEWS of Nashville Skyline

Guest access
Guests have access to entire home except locked storage closets.

Other things to note
★★Must Climb Stairs★★ There are 3 FULL Flights of stairs in the house.
